decisions.reason: Uses the tag listing and the HEAD:main-only sync push to explain v0.9.5 never reached the mirror, explicitly ruling out network/command faults.
Explains v0.9.7 was built against the newer 0.1.2-alpha.1 client API (useConversation seat) while the runtime is older 0.1.1-rc.2, and notes install/restart success does not imply compatibility.

Honors the freeze, correctly notices v0.9.3 is absent from the mirror and does not require a DSH upgrade, but pins #v0.9.1 whose rc-line compatibility is only inferred, instead of the rubric's v0.9.3 after tag publication or a verified commit.
Proposes explicit tag pushes (per-tag or --tags) for every mirror plus an ls-remote verification gate; branch-only push alone is not offered as sufficient.
Proposes a published compat matrix with per-runtime install commands (rc.x line vs >=0.1.2-alpha.1), a dsh --version check, and no blanket support for untested future alphas.
